name: Electric Minimal Car
summary: The quiet electric car. A smooth, closed body with no grille, flush handles and a glass roof. The cabin is bare, in recycled cloth, with one large screen in place of dials.

philosophy.core_thesis: An electric car has no engine to show. It is a smooth, quiet shell with a bare cabin, and a screen holds all of the controls.
design_principles: Close the grille, and mark the face by a thin lamp line or a smooth panel.
Make the surface smooth, with a drag coefficient below 0.28, and fit flush door handles.
Raise a low, wide stance, with large wheels of 19 to 21 inches pushed to the corners.
Use a glass roof that extends over the cabin, so that the cabin is full of light.
Keep the cabin bare, with one large screen and no physical dials, and a few clean surfaces.
Trim the seats in recycled knit, felt or non-leather material, in two or three calm colours.
Use thin lamps in a single line, front and rear, and a plain badge.
anti_patterns: Fake wood and gloss black trim
A dashboard of many physical switches

silhouette.shape: A smooth, low-drag body with a short bonnet, a long wheelbase, a fast roof and a tail that is cut off or tapered.
silhouette.line: One clean line from the nose over the roof to the tail, and a thin, level shoulder line.
silhouette.fit: A spacious, flat-floor cabin with a high, light roof of glass; the seats are thin and the dash is low.
silhouette.proportion: Length 4.4 to 5.1 m; wheelbase 2.8 to 3.1 m; wheels 19 to 21 inches; short overhangs; drag below 0.28.
rules: Close the front as a smooth panel, with a thin lamp line.
Set flush handles into the body surface.
Place one large screen as the only display, and keep other controls out of the dash.
Finish the cabin in 2 or 3 calm, matte materials, with no bright trim.

fabrics.rule: Use light metal, recycled fibre and plain plastic. Use aluminium for the shell, and knit and felt for the seats and the dash. Do not use a part that imitates wood or chrome.

methods: aluminium and steel body shaped for low drag
flush handles driven by a motor
recycled polyester knit made in one piece
one large touch screen in place of dials
flat battery pack in the floor
construction.closures: Flush or pop-out handles, a key card or a phone key, and a power tailgate.
construction.details: A closed front, a thin lamp bar, a glass roof, flush handles, a single central screen and a flat floor with no tunnel.

surface.pattern: Plain colour on the body; a plain, tonal knit or felt in the cabin, with no applied pattern.
surface.gloss: Metallic paint at 70–85 GU; the matte cabin at 5–10 GU; the glass is dark.
surface.wear: The glossy screen shows fingerprints, the matte paint marks, and the knit holds dust; software updates change the look of the screen.

palette.strategy: Quiet, light colours such as white, silver, grey and a dark blue, and a cabin in grey, white and one soft accent.

making.scale: Mass-made in the tens or hundreds of thousands, on a skateboard platform; the cabin and the screen are the same across the range.
making.signs: A closed face, flush handles, a glass roof, a bare dash with one screen and a cabin in recycled knit.

pieces.form: Smooth four-door fastback with a closed face and flush handles
Compact electric hatchback with a thin lamp bar
Bare dash with one large screen and a felt-covered shelf
Thin seats in recycled polyester knit
Large flat aero wheel in aluminium

emotion.target_response: A calm, clear mood. The viewer sees a quiet, smooth shell and a bare cabin that wants nothing from the driver.

use_cases: a launch image for an electric car
a car interior concept for a minimal cabin
an image prompt for a modern EV
a product page for a charging service
avoid_when: the brief wants a retro or a classic look
the brief wants chrome and ornament
the brief wants a loud, aggressive sports car

modifiers.how: Add round lamps, chrome rings and a painted dash panel, and use a houndstooth seat.
Round every corner, paint the bumpers in body colour and use a bright, soft knit.

ornament_level.note: The style has almost no ornament; a thin lamp line is the only mark.
